sections.markdown:
## E-two — Competitive teardown

No competitor product covering Hawaii the licensing and responsibilities of large-vehicle drivers, the visibility, space, stopping, acceleration, downgrade and slipstream limitations of large vehicles, hazardous materials and emergency equipment, towing trailers safely, and sharing the road with motorcycles at intersections, in lanes, when following and when passing was reviewed, so this teardown names no rival, quotes no price, compares no structure and records no praise or complaint.

The adopt-and-beat analysis of the master template is explicitly out of scope for this handbook-section dossier; a future market pass with its own sources would own it.

Pedagogy, practice-item and coverage comparison tables are therefore absent by explicit scope choice, not by omission.

Disposition: teardown for this section is present as an explicit scoped statement, not as researched competitive evidence.

corpus_stability.reason: The Hawaii Driver's Manual is a periodically reprinted reference (imprint HMG 5/2023, copyright line through 2023); the the licensing and responsibilities of large-vehicle drivers, the visibility, space, stopping, acceleration, downgrade and slipstream limitations of large vehicles, hazardous materials and emergency equipment, towing trailers safely, and sharing the road with motorcycles at intersections, in lanes, when following and when passing rules on pages 85–94 are statutory and procedural content that changes less than once a year, so no BlockedProbe.
